```{ojs}
//| output: false
Plot = require("@observablehq/plot")
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
all = (await FileAttachment("penguins.csv").csv({typed: true}))
  .filter(d => d.sex && d.bill_length_mm != null)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
speciesList = ["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
islandList = Array.from(new Set(all.map(d => d.island))).sort()
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
massExtent = d3.extent(all, d => d.body_mass_g)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
colorScale = {
  return {
    domain: speciesList,
    range: ["#ff8c00", "#a034f0", "#159090"],
    legend: true
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
filtered = all.filter(d =>
  species.includes(d.species) &&
  islands.includes(d.island) &&
  (sex === "All" || d.sex === sex.toUpperCase()) &&
  d.body_mass_g >= massRange[0] && d.body_mass_g <= massRange[1]
)
```

```{=html}
<style>
  .value-box-area .observablehq { font-size: 2.8rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; }
</style>
```

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof species = Inputs.checkbox(speciesList, {label: "Species", value: speciesList})
```

```{ojs}
viewof islands = Inputs.checkbox(islandList, {label: "Island", value: islandList})
```

```{ojs}
viewof sex = Inputs.radio(["All", "Female", "Male"], {label: "Sex", value: "All"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof massRange = {
  const lo = Inputs.range(massExtent, {label: "Min mass (g)", step: 50, value: massExtent[0]});
  const hi = Inputs.range(massExtent, {label: "Max mass (g)", step: 50, value: massExtent[1]});
  const form = html`<div>${lo}${hi}</div>`;
  const update = () => form.value = [Math.min(lo.value, hi.value), Math.max(lo.value, hi.value)];
  update();
  form.oninput = e => {
    if (e.target === form) return;
    e.stopPropagation();
    update();
    form.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
  };
  return form;
}
```

## Column {width=25%}

::: {.valuebox icon="database" color="primary"}
Penguins shown

`{ojs} filtered.length.toLocaleString()`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="speedometer2" color="info"}
Avg body mass (g)

`{ojs} filtered.length ? Math.round(d3.mean(filtered, d => d.body_mass_g)).toLocaleString() : "–"`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="geo-alt" color="success"}
Islands

`{ojs} new Set(filtered.map(d => d.island)).size`
:::

## Column {width=75%}

### Row {height=60%}

::: {.card title="Bill length vs. depth"}
```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 760,
  height: 340,
  grid: true,
  x: {label: "Bill length (mm)", domain: d3.extent(all, d => d.bill_length_mm), nice: true},
  y: {label: "Bill depth (mm)", domain: d3.extent(all, d => d.bill_depth_mm), nice: true},
  color: colorScale,
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(filtered, {
      x: "bill_length_mm", y: "bill_depth_mm", fill: "species",
      fillOpacity: 0.7, r: 3.5,
      title: d => `${d.species}, ${d.island}\n${d.sex.toLowerCase()}, ${d.body_mass_g} g`,
      tip: true
    })
  ]
})
```
:::

### Row {height=40%}

::: {.card title="Species by island"}
```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 400,
  height: 200,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: {label: "Penguins"},
  y: {label: null, domain: islandList},
  color: colorScale,
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(filtered, Plot.groupY({x: "count"}, {y: "island", fill: "species"})),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```
:::

::: {.card title="Body mass distribution"}
```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 400,
  height: 200,
  x: {label: "Body mass (g)", domain: [massExtent[0] - 100, massExtent[1] + 100]},
  y: {label: null},
  color: colorScale,
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(filtered, Plot.binX({y: "count"}, {x: "body_mass_g", fill: "species", thresholds: 25})),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```
:::
